Question: As-Salam-O-Alaikum, My elder brother Murhoom Sayed Fazle Elahi died during the life time of our father & mother leaving six children (now five as one died). Please state wheather children of Murhoom Sayed Fazle Elahi have any right or claim over the property of their grand father & grand mother. Answer ID: 14753 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1330/1085=D/1430) If Fazle Ilahi died in the presence of his parents, his children will have no shares in the property of their grandparents; since there are some other brothers of Fazle Ilahi (who will inherit their property). But, it was better for grandparents to give something as gift in their lifetime to their grandchildren. Or now the brothers of Fazle Ilahi, after receiving his shares, should give something to the children of late brother as benefaction and goodwill. This will be a great cause of good conduct with relatives. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
